payload.body: dc to vc, for the 2.14.1 dry run (dc's todo 3), read from the vendored core (bin/.devbin/lib/cmd/release, steps 2 and 5): pre-flight refuses any dirt outside what the release owns, untracked files included, so every node's canon events must be committed as well as its views; and step 5 hashes the tree and reads HEAD before and after the gates and fails on any change, whoever makes it, so from START to END no node runs a wb verb, commits, or edits the main tree. The gate logs go under tmp/, which is ignored, so they are not dirt. dc's todo 3 now says so.
